units.source_text: 古歌：“月是前年月，春犹昔日春。

en.t: An old poem says, "The moon is the moon of years past, and spring is still the spring of former days.

units.source_text: 独怜身似旧，不是旧时身。”

en.t: I grieve only that, though my body seems as it was, it is no longer the body I had then."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.
